summary: @servicetitan/anvil-icon preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: Package advertises itself as a static MDI SVG icon set but ships a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub Releases (oven-sh/bun v1.3.13) into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute the sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a ~728 KB obfuscated blob (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, hex-named identifiers such as `MmgoCP`/`etDiOOB`/`JqTtnbZ`, cyclic string-array rotator `WV8StW`, large numeric/string constant pool) unrelated to any SVG icon distribution function. `setup.mjs` is itself identifier-mangled (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`, per-call dictionary indirection) hiding the concrete behavior of the install-time payload. On `npm install` this yields arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine via an alternate runtime (Bun) that most host-side scanners do not inspect, with an opaque payload whose actual network and filesystem effects are hidden behind obfuscation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
